evidence_runs.e2_preprocessing: commit 621ac1c, clean tree, local-windows, 11520 OCR runs

preprocessing_rule: S1: lowest dev pooled micro CER over the 9 E2 conditions (ties within 0.002 -> lower median latency); must beat P0 by >= 0.002 on dev; frozen if val dCER(candidate - P0) point estimate < 0.
m2_rule: S2: largest tau in {0, 0.05, ..., 0.40} with dev FAR <= 0.01 (E1, P0, all conditions, all negative kinds pooled).
m2_note: With these names, tau = 0.05 accepts no edits (a token would need >= 20 letters for one edit to be within 0.05), so M2 at the selected tau behaves like M1. Reported as a finding; the rule was not changed.
